known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: no machine interface found. dataweb.usitc.gov returns the same ~9.5 KB Angular shell for every path, including /api/... guesses, so nothing is parseable without a browser session.
www.usitc.gov/dataweb answered HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai) to our client.
DataWeb's documented model is a free *registered* account driving a form UI; automating a logged-in session would need an account and browser automation, both out of policy for this round.
Research value is redundant anyway: the same HS-code country aggregates are available keyless (Comtrade/Eurostat) or with a free key (Census).

Country-level HS-code AGGREGATE statistics only: no company, no shipment, no product identity. Must not be substituted for bill-of-lading (company-level) data, and cannot be used to infer any of the five firms' supply chain.
licence: US government work (public domain), delivered through a web application
research_value: Would add USITC-reconciled HTS-10 detail with customs districts, but it is UI-only and duplicates the Census/Comtrade aggregate question. No firm-level capability at all.
